subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lead-in: jobs in tourism and hospitality; reading five job texts
outcomes: List the skills and qualities needed for five tourism jobs
Match job responsibilities with the right jobs

tf.s: A tour guide needs good communication skills and languages.
tf.why: Tour guides talk to tourists from many countries.

tf.s: A chef needs a passion for food and cooking.
tf.why: Chefs love food and create menus.

tf.s: Airline cabin crew need a mixture of skills, like a nurse, chef, waiter and cleaner.
tf.why: Cabin crew do many different tasks on a flight.

tf.s: A travel agent does not need computer skills.
tf.why: Travel agents use computers to organise and book trips.

tf.s: A hotel manager must be patient to handle problems pleasantly.
tf.why: Patience helps the manager keep staff and guests happy.

tf.s: Public speaking is a skill that tour guides rarely use.
tf.why: Tour guides speak to groups all the time, so public speaking is important.

tf.s: Sales skills are useful for a travel agent.
tf.why: Travel agents sell holidays and trips to customers.

tf.s: Creating menus is a main responsibility of cabin crew.
tf.why: Creating menus is a chef's job.

tf.s: A hotel manager only needs to keep the guests happy, not the staff.
tf.why: A good hotel manager keeps both staff and guests happy.

tf.s: Hotel managers, chefs and tour guides all work in the farming industry.
tf.why: These jobs belong to tourism and hospitality.

boxes.q: Which job needs languages to talk to tourists?
boxes.why: Tour guides communicate with visitors from different countries.

boxes.q: Which job books trips for customers?
boxes.why: Travel agents organise and sell travel.
Cabin crew look after passengers during flights.
The hotel manager is in charge of the hotel.

boxes.q: Which quality helps a hotel manager handle problems?
boxes.why: Patience keeps problems calm and guests happy.

boxes.q: Which skill helps a travel agent stay organised?
boxes.why: Travel agents must organise many bookings.

boxes.q: What industry do these five jobs belong to?
boxes.why: All five jobs serve travellers and guests.
Responsibilities are the duties of a job.

boxes.q: Which job needs public speaking most?
boxes.why: Tour guides speak to groups of tourists.

hunt.q: Job: in charge of a hotel
A chef has a passion for ...

mcq.q: Which job needs 'a mixture of skills' like a nurse, chef, waiter and cleaner?
mcq.why: Cabin crew care for passengers, serve food and keep the plane tidy.

mcq.q: Which is a skill of a travel agent?
mcq.why: Travel agents use computers to book trips.

mcq.q: Which is a skill of a chef?
mcq.why: Chefs create menus and love cooking.

mcq.q: Which skills does a tour guide need?
mcq.why: Tour guides talk with and guide tourists.

mcq.q: A guest complains loudly about a noisy room. Which job holder should stay calm and solve it pleasantly?
mcq.why: A patient hotel manager handles problems and keeps guests happy.

mcq.q: A group of tourists from Japan, Germany and Brazil visits Nizwa. Which skill helps their guide most?
mcq.why: Languages help the guide communicate with tourists from different countries.

mcq.q: Sara is very organised, good with computers and likes selling. Which job suits her best?
mcq.why: These are the key skills of a travel agent.

mcq.q: Why must a hotel manager be patient?
o: To handle problems pleasantly while keeping staff and guests happy
So he can cook for guests
mcq.why: Patience helps a manager solve problems calmly.

mcq.q: Why does a tour guide need languages?
o: To communicate with tourists from different countries
mcq.why: Tourists come from many countries and speak different languages.

mcq.q: Which statement shows the difference between a skill and a quality?
o: A skill is learned, like using a computer; a quality is part of your character, like patience
A skill and a quality are always the same
A quality is a machine you use at work
A skill is only about cooking
mcq.why: Skills are abilities you learn; qualities describe your personality.
